idea-plugin.name: SolKey
idea-plugin.description:
Prove a Solidity contract or function with KeY.

Click the ▶ beside any public function in a .sol file to open KeYther, the SolKey prover GUI, on that function's proof obligation — no function picker in between. A function no obligation can be generated for (one that returns a value, or takes a parameter with no .key sort) is refused with the reason. The ▶ beside a contract covers every function it declares.

Right-click a ▶ for the other two tools on the same target: the headless prover, which reports N/M closed and the remaining sequents in a console, and solc, which compiles the contract and runs it on an in-process EVM — so a failing assert is reported as such, without a proof.

No Solidity language plugin is required: the declarations are found by scanning the file.

action.description: Open KeYther on the Solidity function or contract at the caret
Prove the Solidity function or contract at the caret in a console
Compile with solc and run it on an in-process EVM, reporting any failing assert
